calls.head: Vegas’s power play has a target
calls.body: Vegas ranks 2nd of 32 on the power play (9.0 expected goals per 60); Toronto ranks 31st on the penalty kill.
calls.call: Vegas’s power play creates at least its usual 9.0 expected goals per 60.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season
calls.happened: Vegas’s power play created 9.8 expected goals per 60 in 8:00 of 5-on-4 time, against its usual 9.0, and scored 0 goals.

calls.head: Toronto gives up shots, and Vegas takes them
calls.body: Vegas ranks 7th of 32 for shot volume (60.4 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Toronto ranks 28th for shot suppression.
calls.call: Vegas takes at least its usual 60.4 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season
calls.happened: Vegas took 68.1 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5 (adjusted for score and venue), against its usual 60.4.

calls.head: Quality over quantity for Vegas
calls.body: Vegas ranks 7th of 32 for shot quality (one expected goal for every 15.0 unblocked shots); Toronto ranks 22nd for keeping shots to the outside.
calls.call: Vegas needs no more than its usual 15.0 unblocked shots per expected goal.
calls.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 4 and 4 games this season
calls.happened: Vegas needed 15.8 unblocked shots per expected goal, against its usual 15.0.

VGK.head: We gave Vegas a 81% chance, and Vegas delivered.

TOR.head: We gave Toronto only a 19% chance, and it went the way we feared.

surprises.head: Toronto hardly hit anyone
surprises.body: Toronto’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 41, against its usual 90 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). Over the last three seasons, a team strayed this far about once every 20 games.

surprises.head: A big night for S. Bobrovsky
surprises.body: S. Bobrovsky allowed 3 goals on shots worth 5.1 expected goals, 2.1 fewer than expected. Starting goalies had a night this good about once every 15 starts over the last three seasons.
